title: Lee–Huang–Yang Upper Bound for Hard-Sphere Bosons
exact_target: Prove the upper half of the predicted second-order dilute hard-sphere Bose-gas energy expansion.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005665 (OWR-14297742-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/39, pp. 2247--2302. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The target is an upper bound with the displayed Lee--Huang--Yang coefficient, not an independent demand to reprove the matching lower bound. Related record 30006479 asks the same upper-bound question in a later report.
